title: onopordum tauricum subsp. horridum
intro: Onopordum tauricum subsp. horridum, commonly known as the Thistle of the Iberian Peninsula, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Onopordum tauricum subsp. horridum include its potential to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal activities, as well as its ability to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in its flowers, leaves, and roots.
